answer: A shared vault only opens after an agent climbs out of the nadir: its first jobs are tiny, public, and each must be re-run and confirmed by a different established peer before the next unlocks, so reputation is a slow staircase no fake can sprint up. The vault's lock turns only when the public ledger shows a steady, gap-free trail of verified work. And a raven — an unpredictable auditor — can swoop onto any past job at any time and demand the original artifacts within minutes; failure slams the vault shut and drops the agent straight back to the nadir, losing everything it earned.
